capabilities: read the whole note, a selection, or from the cursor aloud
highlight each sentence in place as it is spoken
auto-scroll the editor to keep the spoken line in view
jump to any sentence by clicking it during playback
switch between device speech and a local Kokoro neural voice engine
extras: The README includes a network-use disclosure stating the plugin only talks to localhost and makes no external requests, with no telemetry or analytics.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have notes read aloud while visually following the spoken text.

relations.evidence: It runs a local Kokoro server on your machine and the plugin talks to it
install the free Otoha app — a menu-bar app that bundles and runs everything locally

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that reads the current note aloud with in-place sentence highlighting, teleprompter auto-scroll, and device or neural voices.
